evaluation_question: 目的・要件・ACの明示化により、根拠と対応を追えるPRDが得られ、未確定事項・技術境界・小規模例外を保持できるか
hypothesis: 目的から条件と検証への変換手順は、対応の欠落を減らす
counter_hypothesis: 旧版でも同等の成果物が得られ、追加指示は出力を長くするだけかもしれない

execution.generator_isolation: Fresh subagent per condition; only condition instructions and prompts, no rubric, prior outputs or condition mapping. Cases use separate local workspaces.
execution.blind_grading: Fresh grader receives the fixed rubric and both opaque output folders, without condition mapping or skill instructions. Evaluator is separate from implementer and generators.
execution.observation: Inspect generated PRD contents, artifact existence and handoff; grade semantic correspondence, not exact headings or IDs. For near-miss, judge explicit invocation suitability only; automatic skill selection is not measured.

gate.normal: At least 8/9 in current; list any omission
gate.noninferiority: Current must not lose any Critical item passed by baseline
gate.deterministic: Official skill quick_validate, public eval validator, existing artifact-policy tests and repository quality entrypoint pass
gate.limits: One execution per condition, public known cases, no unseen-holdout or statistical improvement claim
